ImportExport.Hint: Allows importing and exporting custom Assistant templates.

Yes: existing templates will be deleted.
No: new templates will be added to the existing ones.

Unique.Disabled: Disabled for unique actors (Characters and NPCs / Creatures with "Link Actor Data" enabled)

GenerateName.Label: Random Name
GenerateName.Hint: If enabled, a random name will be generated for the actor's token when dropped on the canvas.

Keys.Value: Available parameters for the selected species:
Keys.Hint:
To add a specific word or character to the name, simply type it in.
To select mutually exclusive parameters, words, or characters, list them separated by the "|" symbol.
For example: with the parameter "Male|Female", only one of them will be randomly selected.
Keys.Error: These parameters are not available for the selected species or subspecies:

RandomCharacteristics.Label: Random Characteristics
RandomCharacteristics.Hint:
If enabled, random characteristics will be generated for the actor's token when dropped on the canvas, according to the Rulebook.

Sets random characteristic values by subtracting 10 points from the specified value, and then adding 2d10 points. Thus, a specified characteristic value of 30 will turn into a random one equal to 20 + 2d10. If the characteristic is 5, it simply rolls 1d10 and sets the result as the new characteristic value.

RandomTokenSize.Label: Random Token Size
RandomTokenSize.Hint: If enabled, the actor's token size will be randomly changed within ±20% when dropped on the canvas.

DeathTint.Label: Token Tint
DeathTint.Hint: If the actor's wounds are reduced to 0, the token will be tinted with the specified color.
DeathTint.Evenly: Evenly tint the token upon taking damage.

GenerateSpells.Label: Random Spells
GenerateSpells.Hint: If enabled, the specified number of random spells from the selected Magic Lore will be given to the token when dropped on the canvas.
GenerateSpells.Arcane: If enabled, Arcane spells will be added to the search pool.

Disposition.Label: Token Disposition
Disposition.Hint: Changes the token's disposition when dropped on the canvas.
Disposition.Tooltip: Choose what disposition the dropped token will have.

Reactions.Label: Reactions
Reactions.Hint: If enabled, the actor will react with random phrases to various events.

Frequency.Title: Chance for the actor to react to events.

Presets.Label: Presets
Presets.Hint: Allows randomly changing equipment and characteristics presets for the actor when dropped on the canvas.

ReplaceTokens.Label: Token
ReplaceTokens.Hint:
Overwrites the Image File values for token generation. Leave blank if it doesn't matter.
Current path to Image File:
• "{path}"
Current Image File:
• "{file}"

Weight.Label: Weight
Weight.Hint: The higher the value, the higher the chance of getting this preset.

Presets.ReplaceKeys: Allows overwriting the generation keys for the selected preset. Leave blank to use the already specified keys.

enableHelpers.Name: Assistant
enableHelpers.Hint: If enabled, an Assistant setting will appear in actor sheets to help optimize your actors.

reactionsSend.Name: Reactions Display Method
reactionsSend.Hint: Determine how reactions will be displayed.

Save.Title: Save
Save.Tooltip: Saves tokens currently on the scene as a new template.<hr>Characters and actors whose data are linked to the token are not saved.

Load.Title: Load
Load.Tooltip: Loads tokens from the selected template onto the scene.<hr>If multiple templates are selected, one will be determined randomly.<hr>Alt + LMB: existing tokens will be deleted upon loading.

Dialog.Title: Delete existing tokens
Dialog.Tooltip:
Should existing tokens be removed from the scene before adding new ones?
Characters and actors whose data are linked to the token will not be deleted.

Remove.Title: Clear
Remove.Tooltip: Deletes tokens currently on the scene.<hr>Characters and actors whose data are linked to the token are not deleted.

Dialog.Title: Confirm token deletion
Dialog.Tooltip:
This action will delete tokens currently on the scene.
Characters and actors whose data are linked to the token will not be deleted.
Do you agree?
